##  {.rail-slide}

::: rail
![](images/cpp-icon-green.png){.rail-logo fig-alt="Cal Poly Pomona"}
:::

:::::: speaker-grid
:::: speaker-text
[Dr. Cailin Kuchenbecker]{.speaker-name}

[Assistant Professor, Department of Communications]{.speaker-role}
[California State University, Fullerton]{.speaker-role}

Dr. Kuchenbecker teaches public relations, advertising, and strategic
communication. Her research in strategic, health, and crisis
communication examines how persuasive messages can promote public
health, safety, and social well-being.

::: bg-label
Background
:::

- Ph.D. in Communication, Chapman University
- M.B.A. and B.S. in Communication, Cal Poly Pomona
- Multiple Top Paper awards, Eastern Communication Association
